note: IDs are append-only. Never renumber or reuse an ID; retire an entry with "retired": true and take the next ID from next_id for new entries. Placement (plan step 15) reads per_hectare (plants per hectare by biome name, before the density setting in tile_rules.json runtime_flora), moisture (0 to 255 map value), max_slope_deg, altitude_m (ground height above sea level) and water (water classes it may stand in; empty = dry land only). crown_m is the spacing radius of trees and shrubs, trunk_m the collision radius (0 = walk through). yields are names for the harvesting tables to come. season: when the main yield can be gathered (spring, summer, autumn, winter or all). rarity: common, uncommon, rare (a label for players; how often a plant appears comes from per_hectare). uses: what the yields are good for (food, seasoning, sauce, jam, tea, brewing, medicine, ointment, potion, poison, dye, fibre, timber and so on). properties: effects for the crafting tables to come (wound_healing, fever, sleep, toxic, ...).
